requestConstruction.pageBootstrap: Anonymous GET /search?search=<term>[&page=<n>] returns first-party Apollo state with ProductListingResults.meta.initAction.graphql and current contentId.
requestConstruction.querySource: The client uses the current first-party initAction GraphQL text and validates that its embedded URL matches the requested search/page. It does not persist the dynamic contentId.
requestConstruction.queryIdDerivation: The first-party client derives X-ULTA-DXL-QUERY-ID from the GraphQL operation name. This NonCachedPage query has no variables.url.path, so the observed value is NonCachedPage.

observedRules: The action builder creates moduleParams only from first-party action.params and current app context.
The query ID builder uses the operation name and only adds a URL suffix when variables.url.path is supplied.
The request-header builder emits the operation query ID and action customHeaders.

requestConstruction.graphqlBase: Derived from public window.__GRAPHQL_DOMAIN__ and window.__GRAPHQL_GET_URI__ assignments in the HTML response; the current US response points to the same-origin /dxl/graphql route and supplies public query defaults.

moduleParams.gti: empty string; no visitor/account value is copied
moduleParams.retailerVisitorId: omitted; no cookie, visitor ID, or browser session is sent

pageHeaders: x_ulta_site: current first-party public page configuration

pagination.nextPageSource: data.Page.content.loadMoreUrl returned by the observed GraphQL XHR
pagination.method: The client validates the same-origin /search URL, matching search term, and consecutive page number, then fetches that page's public bootstrap to derive its current contentId before replaying its XHR.
pagination.pageSizeArgument: Local maximum number of returned cards, capped at 100; it does not change Ulta's upstream pageSize.

priceSemantics.priceAmounts: Dollar strings are parsed into decimal-string min/max amounts. Ranges are retained as ranges; raw source strings are preserved.
priceSemantics.normalizedOfferFields: Fixed current price is exposed as price.amount/currency/kind; a returned range is exposed as priceRange. Current price uses salePrice only when Ulta supplies a non-null salePrice, otherwise listPrice.
priceSemantics.currencyEvidence: US client-country header, en-US locale, and dollar price strings. USD is assigned only when a dollar amount parses successfully.
priceSemantics.saleObservation: The field was present on all 73–74 returned card rows per page. A live non-null salePrice was observed for a sampled product and parsed separately from listPrice; other rows returned null.

productIdentity.productURL: Same-origin /p/ action URL whose final path segment is bound to productId; an sku query value is retained only when it equals skuId.

productDetail.productUrlInput: Required from a same-origin URL previously returned by the search XHR. The product ID must be the final /p/ path suffix and an optional sku query must match skuId. The client does not invent a product slug.

xhr.querySource: The first-party client bundle exports query Page($url: JSON, $stagingHost: String, $contentId: String, $previewOptions: JSON, $moduleParams: JSON). Variables bind url.path to the observed product path and moduleParams.sku to the verified SKU when present.
xhr.identity: Returned ProductPricing productId and skuId are matched against the requested product and optional SKU; ProductReviews productId and productSku are independently checked.

priceSemantics.currency: USD, bound to the response ProductReviews.priceCurrency field and the US/en-US storefront.
priceSemantics.listAndSale: ProductPricing productListPrice/listPrice and productSalePrice/salePrice are retained separately; amounts remain decimal strings and price ranges remain explicit.

productDetail.images: Direct Page GraphQL response returns product gallery URLs on the observed media.ulta.com or media.ultainc.com hosts. Variant image links are separately bound to the variant SKU.

reviews.configSource: The product page's first-party ProductReviews module supplies current prApiKey, prMerchantId, locale and productId. The client keeps the public frontend key in process memory only and never returns or records its value.

http.localeBinding: en-US is converted to the SDK's en_US path segment.
http.pageIdBinding: The API results[].page_id must exactly match the Ulta productId.
http.pagination: The first page uses paging.size. Subsequent pages follow the exact server paging.next_page_url after validating same origin, merchant, locale, productId, offset and page size. The SDK computes paging.from=(page-1)*pageSize.

pageSizeBoundary.rejection: HTTP 400 JSON status_code=400 with message 'paging.size maximum value is 25'. The client rejects pageSize>25 before sending.
pageSizeBoundary.verifiedPurchase: Not exposed on the sampled public review records; omitted without inference.
pageSizeBoundary.reviewerProfile: nickname, location and other reviewer profile fields are omitted from returned review objects.
pageSizeBoundary.imageURL: Protocol-relative media[].uri is normalized to HTTPS only after host validation; observed images use res.cloudinary.com. One returned photo URL replayed as HTTP 200 image/jpeg.

limitations: Only the US en-US public storefront and its currently referenced first-party bundle contracts are supported.
A product slug URL must come from search output; productId alone does not reveal a slug and is rejected without productUrl.
Search result rows can exceed the store pageSize because promoted rows are included; sourceItemCount reports returned rows.
The PowerReviews frontend key is public page configuration; it is used in memory and omitted from receipts and results.
Affiliate commission rates and publisher tracking links remain separate from these public catalog and review APIs.
